summary.text: Kathy Burkett is the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 42A in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic incumbent Ned Carroll; the Republican primary was canceled.
She was also the Republican candidate in the district in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kathy Burkett was the Republican candidate for Minnesota House District 42A in 2022, when Ned Carroll won the general election 58.3 percent to 41.7 percent.
She ran against Carroll again in 2024, when he won 57.3 percent to 42.6 percent.
